description: This source file defines a serializable state class and a grain class for testing multifacet factory behavior using Orleans. The grain manages reader and writer interfaces, providing methods to get and set these components.

classes.name: MultifacetFactoryTestGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class holding references to reader and writer interfaces for state persistence.

classes.name: MultifacetFactoryTestGrain
classes.description: Grain class implementing interface methods to retrieve and set reader and writer components, persisted in state.

methods.name: GetReader
methods.description: Returns the reader interface associated with the grain, either from state or provided grain.

methods.name: GetWriter
methods.description: Returns the writer interface associated with the grain, either from state or provided grain.

methods.name: SetReader
methods.description: Sets the reader interface in the grain's state.

methods.name: SetWriter
methods.description: Sets the writer interface in the grain's state.
